title: Servicing Desk Guidance — Applying Payments to Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Rule.** A payment on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan may be applied only while the loan is in active, deferred or nonaccrual status. An installment payment is applied to the oldest unpaid installment first: its billed interest (an interest payment entry) and then its principal share (a principal payment entry marked as a scheduled payment), both pointing to that installment bill. An undesignated remittance follows the product's payment application order across assessed fees, unpaid installments and principal; any amount left after every billed item is paid is a prepayment, handled under the prepayment terms. A remittance the member designates as a prepayment is applied to principal as a prepayment only when no installment is past due; otherwise it first pays the past-due installments. A payoff applies, in order, fees, billed interest, interest accrued since the last due date through the payoff date (booked as a final accrual entry with that date as its period end and due date), any prepayment fee, and all principal, marked as a payoff.

## Loan status and payments

The loan's status on record, read before the payment is applied, decides whether it can take a payment; the loan the payment is applied to is the loan named for it.

| Loan status on record | Payment may be applied |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| deferred | yes |
| nonaccrual | yes |
| applied, declined or paid off | no |

## Order of application, by kind of remittance

| Remittance | Applied to |
|---|---|
| Installment payment | Oldest unpaid installment: its billed interest, then its principal share |
| Undesignated remittance | The product's payment application order across assessed fees, unpaid installments and principal; any remainder after every billed item is a prepayment |
| Designated prepayment, no installment past due | Principal, as a prepayment |
| Designated prepayment, an installment past due | The past-due installments first |
| Payoff | Fees, billed interest, interest from the last due date through the payoff date, any prepayment fee, all principal |

## Hypothetical illustration

A member remits 1500.00 with no designation on a Used Equipment Loan (order: fees, interest, principal) owing a 25.00 fee and an unpaid installment of 1200.00 billed with 300.00 of interest. The remittance pays the 25.00 fee, then the installment's 300.00 of interest and its 900.00 principal share; the 275.00 left after every billed item is paid is a prepayment.
